settlement_source: Hierarchy: NBA official result (nba.com) then ESPN, AP, Reuters, Fox, broadcaster. First official final result; later corrections ignored.
settlement_variable: Team scores strictly more points over full game incl. OT. expiration_value is score string e.g. '112-123' (order undocumented, appears home-away).
timezone: ET per terms; API UTC. Ticker date = originally scheduled date.
tie_handling: No Tie strike listed -> tie pays $0.50 to both sides; practically moot (OT until decided) except abandoned-tied games.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Trades through the final buzzer; Kalshi closes early at the final (close_time back-dated by seconds; a print 9 s after) and settles ~2 min later. Tape (MEMSAC): last non-extreme print 7.1 min before close; YES pinned <= 0.05 from 6.8 min out; final-minute prints all 0.01.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed within 48 h -> stands; cancelled/not started within 48 h -> last fair price; abandoned after tip -> official record only if 48 game-minutes reached or league declares official, else last fair price; forfeit before play -> last fair price; forfeit after start -> league winner; data unavailable 48 h -> last fair price; Market Outcome Review 7.1; Rule 7.2 early expiration.
title_vs_rules_divergences: OT counts and game may be played up to 48 h later
'resolve to a fair price' wording vs PDF 'last fair price'
PDF schedule (10 AM ET, next-day settlement) vs practice (buzzer close, 2-min settlement)
toxicity_flags: In-game market through the buzzer: lower-latency feeds (arena/broadcast/league JSON) beat ESPN polling; exploitable window is before the game is decided, not the final minute
Tape dominated by 0.01 lottery buys and giant NO unwinds (49,926 and 90,550-contract prints at 0.01); quadratic fees make 1-5c trades expensive
Early close at Exchange discretion; close_time approximate
Game may be played up to 48 h later
First official result governs within ~2 min
Informed counterparties (prohibited-trader list acknowledges MNPI risk)
notes: No post-final verifier edge (market closes at the final). S6 remains observe-only; in-game model skill must be shown on the scoreboard first. ESPN/NBA feed latency vs arena clock not measured.
